reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Tim Flannery, co-founder of venture fund administrator Passthrough.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Tim Flannery, co-founder of venture fund administrator Passthrough. Passthrough is removing friction from the manual, time-consuming fundraising process by making investor onboarding as simple and automatic as possible. Their software helps investors fill out subscription documents in minutes rather than hours and allows GPs to easily track LP subscriptions during a fundraise.

key_points.text: In our conversation, we discuss the power of identity as a feature to build products around, the double-edged sword of solving an unsexy problem.
